_meta.notes: Form titled '2024 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'; cover and Summary Page entries are handwritten. Neither amendment box (Yes/No) is visibly checked. Cover cells truncate on overflow: Office prints 'Salt Lake County Council At-Larg', Office Sought prints 'Salt Lake County Cou', District Number prints 'At-Large ('. County Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p4) are 'See Attached Schedule' stubs with all grid/subtotal/total cells blank. Other Campaign Accounts section (p5-7) present and entirely blank. p10 and p11 are completely blank pages. Contributions attachment Address column is bar-redacted on every row (single wide column; no city/state survives). Attachments print no subtotal or total; reconciliation is against Summary Column A only. Column B on the Summary is headed 'Aggregate Total'. Expenditure-side 'In-kind (...)' purpose rows are reimbursements of in-kind expenses fronted by the candidate and others; the four contribution-side '(In-kind)' rows (311.80/200/150/288) mirror expenditure rows 25/26/27/34.
